title: Self-Driving Car Test: Steve Mahan
summary: Google's 2012 video of Steve Mahan, who is legally blind, taking a drive in its self-driving car including a drive-through stop. It was shared as a human-interest demonstration of the technology's promise.
why: Cited as an early milestone of autonomous driving, and later as an example of over-optimistic timelines.

quote.text: They've been working with the guy in the video for over 6 years [1]
